new_claim.statement: For independent cap-one physical coordinates on two m-coordinate banks and an invertible physical cross block C, arbitrary same-bank quadratic and affine terms are allowed and |phi(t)|^2<=min(1,pi^m |t|^{-m}|det C|^{-1}). Hence for 0<alpha<m/2, H_alpha has the exact integrated bound in r19; at m=2, H_1/2<=4sqrt(2)|det C|^{-1/4}. After one genuine physical square pivot d, ||p_Q||inf<=4sqrt(2)|d|^{-1/2}|det C|^{-1/4}.

mechanism: Use the exact independent-copy identity with U=X-X', V=X+X'. Keep their dependent joint density unnormalized: F(u,v)=1/2 f((u+v)/2)f((v-u)/2). Its partial Fourier slice K has ||K||_2^2<=pi. Cauchy-Schwarz between two physical banks plus square changes of variables of determinant |t|^m|det C| gives the characteristic-function estimate. No conditional sum/difference cap is used.

partner_applied.application: Applied the partner overlap-one k=3 transducer to its Walsh A_t family, obtaining its t^{-1/6}-divergent bound, then applied the new r19 physical 2x2 endpoint to the same family to obtain the uniform bound 32sqrt(2)/33^(1/4)<18.882.

structural_observation: For the partner Walsh family, pivot 1 and residual pairs {2,3},{4,6} have det S=-(1-t)^2(1+t)/(4(5t+3)); the corresponding overlap-one 3x3 original minor equals -(1-t)^2(1+t)/32 and stays uniformly nonzero although the partner fourth-order overlap-one bank collapses.
failed_mechanism: A naive three-coordinate equal-weight L2 Brascamp-Lieb closure of the unnormalized slice maps is singular for every symmetric 3x3 B because the three kernel generators sum to zero.
first_unpaid_implication: Build an aggregate-before-inversion compiler for the natural third-compound mass sum_{|R|=|C|=3} det(A[R,C])^2=e_3(A^2)>=1, partitioned by intersection sizes q=0,1,2,3. The new r19 theorem locally pays q=1 atoms, but selecting one small atom can lose dimension; failure of q=1 aggregation should transfer quantitatively to an already-paid q=0, q=2, q=3, diffuse-Fresnel, ridge, or grouped-bank branch.
